contracts: (The cross-case selector deterministically rejects mismatched evidence and reports both case identities with a binding-mismatch reason.) AND (The isolated relabel selector deterministically yields aggregate reject with case provenance and unchanged companion inputs.)
selector_intents: Fail if the relabel fixture cannot execute or cannot attribute the aggregate decision to the relabelled case.
Fail if the substitution fixture cannot execute or cannot prove source-case and target-case attribution.
Run only the relabelled historical-case selector against the pre-repair evaluator; the required red observation is aggregate rejection.
Run the isolated cross-case substitution selector against the pre-repair evaluator and observe rejection of mismatched evidence binding.
